column4: \tこの国には貧乏人だが屈強な農民が多い
column5: This country has many poor but sturdy farmers.

column4: \t武具を与えて戦争に駆り出せ。
column5: Give them weapons and send them off to war.

column4: \t積極的に協力してくれる人はもう参加してくれています
column5: Those willing to cooperate actively have already joined.

column4: \t参加していないのはそれこそ家族を守る、その日の暮らしで精一杯な人達で・・
column5: Those who haven't joined are the ones barely making a living, protecting their families day by day...

column4: \tだから、そいつらに戦争が終わったら２０年間家族も含めて生活を保障すると言えばいい
column5: So, just promise them that when the war ends, their families and they will be guaranteed support for 20 years.

column4: \tそんな予算ありません。数万以上ですよね・・
column5: We don't have that kind of budget. It's tens of thousands, right...

column4: \t大丈夫だ、数万以上集めても戦争が終わる頃には１／１０ぐらいになっているはずだ
column5: Don't worry, even if we gather tens of thousands, by the time the war ends, only about one tenth will remain.

column4: \tランスの無茶苦茶な指示により、７万ほどの兵士が集まった
column5: Due to Rance's reckless orders, about 70,000 soldiers have been gathered.
